subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should this release accept the one-way migration that makes SQLite the sole runtime device-identity store and requires `openclaw doctor --fix` before legacy JSON installations can start?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the durable cryptographic-identity upgrade and downgrade contract; mechanical review cannot decide whether that operational tradeoff is acceptable for this release.

options.title: Accept the documented cutover
options.body: Approve the Doctor-required migration and coordinated-upgrade requirement, then merge only after the normal exact-head checks settle.

options.title: Defer to a coordinated release
options.body: Do not merge this branch until maintainers want to support the one-way identity-store transition and its downgrade limitation.

recommendation.title: Accept the documented cutover
recommendation.body: Approve the Doctor-required migration and coordinated-upgrade requirement, then merge only after the normal exact-head checks settle.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor supplied the implementation, migration design, and the related state-migration sequencing context; a repository release owner should make the final acceptance decision.
